character_types: well-dressed intellectual in suit and sunglasses
visual_synopsis: Two village workers - one in a red cap and knit vest, one with a black mop-cut wig and striped tank top - dig a hole with shovels in a grassy orchard while a man in a light suit and dark sunglasses lounges by his blue SUV with a folding chair, table and a drink, supervising them. Most of the runtime is close-up back-and-forth talking between the two diggers; at the end one man is left lying face-down in the grass beside the finished hole while the other walks off.
